name: Terraform
description: Declarative infrastructure as code for provisioning cloud and on-premises resources across every managed environment, with state kept remotely and plans reviewed before apply.
rationale: The default tool for new estates. Existing Pulumi stacks stay until their next major revision, when they move across with the migration guide.

name: Kubernetes
description: Container orchestration for every service that needs more than one instance, scheduled across zones with autoscaling and rolling updates.
rationale: Managed control planes only; self-hosted clusters are retired.
note: Run through the shared cluster service

name: Ansible
description: Agentless configuration management, kept for the remaining long-lived hosts until they are rebuilt from images.
rationale: Image builds replace host configuration; no new playbooks.

name: Backstage
description: A developer portal that catalogues services, owners, documentation and scorecards in one place.
rationale: Trial with three teams before a wider roll-out decision in the next edition.

name: Legacy ESB
description: An enterprise service bus the integration estate grew around, now being replaced by event streams and direct APIs.
rationale: Not on the radar: listed so its retirement can be tracked.
